initialization: Fixed A20 head only; Adam and RNG reset identically for all3; all engineering states discarded

losses.L0: Original A20 mean2N SmoothL1_beta0.1(delta_roi-target_roi), reusing original graph
losses.Lratio: meanN SmoothL1_beta0.1(z_long-z_short), exactly old A048 ratio form
losses.limits: Soft, reactive, training-only objective; no hard no-regression, first-step or shared-parameter guarantee. No new inference evidence and no novelty claim from ratio supervision. Fixed coefficients are engineering draft choices, not optimized or empirically justified.

fixed_masks.reference: M on near-only; A20 on gain-only; min(E_M,E_A20) on overlap; inactive entries zero in mean2N
fixed_masks.frozen: Computed only once on complete TRAIN for training. VAL masks only for evaluation, never fed into fit or inference. GT/reference tensors detached. No subset sampler or active-count normalization.

reference_precision: Frozen memberships from saved Python float64 errors, packed bool unchanged. Error thresholds remain float64 GPU; actual decoded float32 candidate divided by float64 GT. No float32 mask recomputation.
inputs: Original A20 fixed_b old B-P3 and common W; all TRAIN5116/5112 outputs; VAL887/886; no GT in forward or inference, no sample filtering
selection: Same expanded eligibility for all3 then lexicographic Sim longMAE,Sim shortMAE,Real longMAE,Real shortMAE,earlier continuation epoch. None eligible => same-key descriptive representative, no adoption.

conditions.domain_M_sizes: Sim long/shortMAE < M-1e-6 each; Real long/shortMAE <= M+0.001 each
conditions.domain_M_near: Fixed M near<=3% long/short MAE <= M+0.001 each domain
conditions.domain_identity: exact M center/raw+canonical angle/score/output presence; new_output=lost_output=0, same center/angle/coverage denominators
conditions.domain_ACI: ACI and valid adjacent-pair count exactly equal M

mechanism: At representatives chosen by same rule, P must reduce protected excess-error loss vs R by >1e-6 in each domain, not lose fixed A20 useful-gain retention vs R beyond 1e-6, and keep Sim eachMAE <= R+1e-6 and <= C+1e-6. Separate local usefulness from full adoption.
reporting: Full original custom mean_RIoU,DFR,ACI,MCML,TDR,AP50/75 supplement; center<15px/output,sizeboth<=10%/output,angle180period<=3deg/GTaspect>=1.2 output; coverage/missing/full-frame correct coverage; overall/domain/video. Protect and harmful-direction statistics do not replace final metrics.

Box replay atol1e-4 rtol1e-6,delta1e-6; discrete/score/presence exact.
